payload.summary: scope: the OpenAI-compatible chat client. POST to the configured base (default https://api.poe.com/v1) /chat/completions with Authorization: Bearer, body of model plus messages; returns reply text AND the response usage object (prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens). Loads POE_API_KEY from a gitignored .env.local; never logs or persists the key. Per-session usage accumulation. Error and timeout handling that returns a failure the caller can degrade on rather than throwing into the game loop. Blocks game-master.
